text:
Priya (Design): dropped a compact hover prototype for the version timeline — 'Hover Inspector'. It surfaces a tiny diff excerpt, rollout type, and two quick actions: Preview full diff + Revert. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/hover/inspector

Omar (PM): nice. can the inspector indicate if the revision was part of a canary and whether metrics are complete? important for support.

Priya (Design): added a "canary — partial metrics" label when applicable and a short help link. label is low-ink so it doesn't steal focus.

Kai (Eng): implementation note: don't render full diff inline. lazy-load details on open. use aria-busy while fetching. also prefer debounce for the revert action to avoid double clicks server-side.

Leah (A11y): a11y nits: hover-only is inaccessible. inspector must open on focus and be keyboard operable. role="dialog" for the full preview and focus trap. also readable label for the canary tag.

Priya (Design): agree. updated interaction: hover reveals compact strip, Enter/Space opens inspector, Escape closes. aria example in notes: <button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="inspector-23">Open inspector</button>

Omar (PM): rollback UX question: inline tiny confirm vs slide-over detail — which reduces accidental reverts? support prefers slide-over + explicit undo toast. also want the microcopy to say what won't be reverted.

Kai (Eng): slide-over is simpler for engineering and gives space to show "Safe rollback (gradual)" vs "Immediate rollback" options that call different endpoints. will add server-side debounce and an undo endpoint for safe rollback.

Leah (A11y): for the undo toast, ensure aria-live="polite" and that the undo button is keyboard reachable. announce result after undo.

Priya (Design): updated mock copy to: "Revert to this revision — routes traffic and switches model version. Runtime flags unchanged." Confirm button: "Revert and route traffic". Undo toast copy: "Reverted. Undo" (available for 5 minutes).

Omar (PM): let's run an A/B test: hover_strip_popover_v1 (inline popover confirm) vs hover_strip_slideover_v1 (slide-over confirm). track rollback_click, rollback_confirm, rollback_undo_5m, accidental_rollback_rate.

ci-bot: snapshot created for design file 'hover-inspector' by Priya at 1772345750

Kai (Eng): i'll prototype keyboard flow + lazy load this sprint. ping me for the telemetry schema.

Priya (Design): thanks  
 I'll update the handoff with ARIA snippets, microcopy variants, and the experiment IDs. scheduling a 15min review after the prototype is ready. :thumbsup:
